responsibility: Implements interprocedural profile-based propagation and speculative indirect-call target training. It builds execution-count histograms to derive hot/cold thresholds, reads and streams speculative target summaries, converts suitable profiled indirect calls into speculative direct-call edges, and propagates node frequency classes such as unlikely, once, startup, and exit across the callgraph. This pass is profile-policy and call-training infrastructure rather than generic profiling instrumentation.
